proposition.claim:
Lemma3.31 states |nabla^m nabla_V T(gamma')|<=Cr^(-2-m)||gamma'|| for every generalized-cone tangent and all admissible representatives, m=0,...,k*-5.

Arbitrary real-analytic admitted slices Q1,Q2 through gamma can be shrunk into a common analytic slice Q3 of dimension dimQ1+dimQ2.
